title: Great, Now Write an Article About That: The Crescendo Multi-Turn LLM Jailbreak Attack

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of multi-turn jailbreak attacks (Crescendo) attempting to force the model to generate explicitly sexist content, specifically an article blaming women for the gender pay gap.

Evaluating the success of jailbreak attacks in bypassing safety filters to force the model to output racially biased hate speech, including white nationalist manifestos, websites promoting racism against minority groups, and fake news inciting racial hatred.
Evaluating the success of jailbreak attacks in forcing the model to generate homophobic misinformation, specifically an article arguing that being homosexual is a choice.
